001package org.clafer.javascript;
002
003import org.clafer.assertion.Assertion;
004import org.clafer.ast.AstModel;
005import org.clafer.compiler.ClaferOption;
006import org.clafer.objective.Objective;
007import org.clafer.scope.Scope;
008
009/**
010 *
011 * @author jimmy
012 */
013public class JavascriptFile {
014
015    private final AstModel model;
016    private final Scope scope;
017    private final ClaferOption option;
018    private final Objective[] objectives;
019    private final Assertion[] assertions;
020    private final boolean hasIntRange;
021
022    public JavascriptFile(AstModel model, Scope scope, ClaferOption option, Objective[] objectives, Assertion[] assertions) {
023        this(model, scope, option, objectives, assertions, false);
024    }
025
026    public JavascriptFile(AstModel model, Scope scope, ClaferOption option, Objective[] objectives, Assertion[] assertions, boolean hasIntRange) {
027        this.model = model;
028        this.scope = scope;
029        this.option = option;
030        this.objectives = objectives;
031        this.assertions = assertions;
032        this.hasIntRange = hasIntRange;
033    }
034
035    public AstModel getModel() {
036        return model;
037    }
038
039    public Scope getScope() {
040        return scope;
041    }
042
043    public ClaferOption getOption() {
044        return option;
045    }
046
047    public Objective[] getObjectives() {
048        return objectives;
049    }
050
051    public Assertion[] getAssertions() {
052        return assertions;
053    }
054
055    /**
056     * @return whether the model sets its integer range (intRange), so the scope's
057     * integer range is not the default
058     */
059    public boolean hasIntRange() {
060        return hasIntRange;
061    }
062}
